archetypes.name: stdout-kv-isolation
archetypes.rationale: The plan's central hazard is render-final-summary.sh stdout polluting the KV result-env stream; this angle verifies the isolation mechanism is fully specified for every driver call site and that the orchestrator verbatim-emit path is a complete substitute for the original un-captured print.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine the plan's stdout-redirection contract for every proposed call to render-final-summary.sh inside design-route.sh: verify that stdout is redirected away from the KV stream on all cancel routes (cancel-title-filter, cancel-reentry-guard), that the plan specifies where stdout is redirected (log file, /dev/null, or other), and that no other net-new driver call can emit to stdout without explicit redirection. Check that the plan's orchestrator verbatim-emit of final-summary.md fully replaces the user-visible summary print that the un-captured inline call previously produced, and that no path leaves the summary silently dropped. Verify that the plan's result-env allowlist check is specified (or that the harness pin covers it) so a leaked key would be caught. Check whether the plan handles the case where render-final-summary.sh writes to both stdout and stderr — confirm the plan does not accidentally suppress stderr banners that must still surface to the operator. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: harness-pin-migration
archetypes.rationale: The plan reframes multiple test-design-structure.sh and test-step0b-router-flag-recovery.sh pins when behavior moves from SKILL.md into drivers; a dedicated pass is needed to verify that every moved string/behavior gets a new driver-side pin and that no existing SKILL.md pin is silently dropped without an equivalent replacement.
archetypes.prompt_body: Cross-reference every behavior the plan moves out of SKILL.md (cancel-title-filter banner, reentry-guard banner, resume env-refresh, contract-drift message, env-refresh-failed message) against the harness update instructions in the plan to verify each moved item has a named driver-side pin in test-design-structure.sh and is not merely deleted. Check that the plan's instruction to 'reframe' (not delete) FINDING_20, Check 20, and Check 21 is specific enough to prevent a silent pin drop — confirm the reframed assertion text is described or that the plan directs the implementer to the correct driver target. Verify that the new pins the plan adds (design-route.sh invokes render-final-summary.sh, design-route.sh accepts --session-id, thinned SKILL.md cancel branches emit final-summary.md verbatim) each have a concrete grep target or assertion form described, not just a high-level directive. Check whether the plan accounts for FINDING_2-family pins that currently assert absence of render-final-summary.sh calls in SKILL.md — if those pins exist, verify the plan explicitly addresses them rather than leaving them to drift. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
